scripts.build: npm run build -w @roulterp/core -w @roulterp/db -w @roulterp/servicios && npm run build -w @roulterp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @roulterp/core -w @roulterp/db -w @roulterp/servicios && npm run typecheck -w @roulterp/web
scripts.test: npm run test:dominio && npm run test:web && npm run test:integracion
scripts.test:web: tsx --test apps/web/test/formulario.test.ts apps/web/test/errores.test.ts apps/web/test/permisos.test.ts apps/web/test/lineas.test.ts apps/web/test/paginacion.test.ts
